Restricted Targets

Find out which targets are restricted when using our Residential Proxies.

Some websites are restricted on our Residential Proxy network to avoid abuse and suspicious activities.

Some targets can be enabled after going through a short KYC procedure. Get in touch with our Customer Support Team if your target falls under the mentioned groups to ensure you can access the target before purchasing.

❗️The list includes but is not limited to targets such as:

Target category
Example

Entertainment & streaming

Netflix, Spotify, Twitch, Disney

Banking and other financial institutions

PayPal, Bank of America, Binance

Government websites

usa.gov, canada.ca

Gaming

Playstation, Steam

Ticketing

Ticketmaster, Eventbrite

Mailing

Outlook, Yahoo mail

Ads

Google Tag Manager, Doubleclick

IP checking websites*

ipinfo.info, 2ip.io

* Please use ip.oxylabs.io ip.oxylabs.io/json or ip.oxylabs.io/location to check your IP address.

Get in touch with our customer support team at support@oxylabs.io or via the 24/7 live chat on our website.
